_source: Spectral signatures used by classify_signal.py. Numbers checked on 10 Sep 2026 against the Signal Identification Wiki, sigidwiki.com/wiki/Category:Amateur_Radio (pages: Radio_Teletype_(RTTY), Phase_Shift_Keying_(PSK), Olivia, Contestia, Multi_Frequency_Shift_Keying_(MFSK), DominoEX, THOR, THROB, MT63, Morse_Code_(CW)), and against the fldigi 4.2.13 manual for the decoder's own parameters. Widths here are the -6 dB extent of the block in a 1.5 Hz-bin max-hold spectrum, narrower than the wiki's quoted occupied bandwidths for PSK.

features.width_hz: extent of the block at -6 dB below its smoothed peak
features.lines: narrow lines inside the block (RTTY has two, PSK and CW one)
features.tone_spacing_hz: median spacing of tone lines in the AVERAGE spectrum of the blocks where the signal is on
features.duty_db: max-hold minus average inside the block: a hopping single-tone mode (Olivia, MFSK, DominoEX, THOR) sits 8 dB or more below its max-hold on average; a continuous one (PSK, MT63, RTTY) within about 3 dB
features.symbol_rate: not measured yet; would separate Contestia from Olivia (same grid, twice the baud) and THOR from DominoEX (same grid)

RTTY.wiki: 170 Hz at 45.45 Bd is the amateur default; 50 Bd/200 Hz Russian; 450 and 850 commercial and maritime; 85 on LF

BPSK63.wiki: 63 Hz (the page also quotes a 160 Hz total footprint)

Olivia.wiki: OLIVIA X/Y, X tones in Y Hz; 8/250 is the common calling submode

Contestia.wiki: Olivia-derived, twice the symbol rate, same X/Y naming
Contestia.note: not separable from Olivia by spectrum; RSID or the symbol rate decides

MFSK16.wiki: 316 Hz, 15.625 Bd (the wiki's tone-count sentence is garbled; fldigi manual: 16 tones at 15.625 Hz)

MFSK8.wiki: same bandwidth as MFSK16 at half the baud

THOR.wiki: same six bandwidths as DominoEX, IFK with FEC
THOR.note: not separable from DominoEX by spectrum; RSID decides

THROB.wiki: 9 tones spaced 8 or 16 Hz, 72 or 144 Hz wide; THROBX 11 tones at 7.8 or 15.6 Hz

MT63.wiki: 64 BPSK carriers in 500, 1000 or 2000 Hz; tolerant of 120 Hz mistuning
MT63.carrier: lower edge plus half the bandwidth
MT63.note: distinguished from Olivia 32/1000 by duty: all carriers on at once

unclassified_policy: a signal with no matching signature is decoded with the dwell's nominal modem at the block centre, RxID on; an RSID burst from the station overrides any classification; during a classified pass RxID is off
